notes: No case suffix or postposition is attached to a placeholder or #: a colon or a carrier noun is used instead ({building} கட்டடத்தை, நிலை {level}).
Plural categories follow Intl.PluralRules("ta"): one for 1 only, other for 0 and everything else.
Generated names use the default setting (first part, space, second part): Tamil puts the modifier before the noun (இடி + சிகரம் = இடி சிகரம்); no sandhi consonant or இன் is added to any part.

Brand and technical names (Kagemura, App Store, Google Play, Game Center, Play Games, IndexedDB, Sentry) stay in Latin letters; the checker's "mostly uses a different script" warnings on those strings come from Latin brand names next to Tamil words whose vowel signs are not counted as letters.
The Japanese statutory pages are translated in full into Tamil; their titles are long (length warnings) because the Japanese legal titles are spelled out.
Computer players' generated names are stored text and stay as generated, as in every language.
